2bad75767a0d30b2.title: Validation [BeforeEach] should validate the communication matrix ports match the node's open ports
2bad75767a0d30b2.ai_summary_short:
---

**TL;DR:** Documented matrix on `release-4.23` lists TCP/8798 and TCP/9192 as active ports, but OCP 4.23 nightly no longer binds them.

**Overall Issue Class:** test_regression
**Overall Severity:** HIGH

## Root Cause Groups

### Group A — Stale documented ports not open on OCP 4.23 nightly (1 failing spec)
- **Tests:** `Validation [BeforeEach] should validate the communication matrix ports match the node's open ports` (`validation_test.go:52`)
- **Classification:** test_regression | **Confidence:** high
- **Evidence:**
  ```
  Ports in matrix but not in use on node:
    Ingress,TCP,8798,openshift-machine-config-operator,machine-config-daemon,...,master,false
    Ingress,TCP,9192,openshift-cluster-machine-approver,machine-approver,...,master,false
    Ingress,TCP,8798,openshift-machine-config-operator,machine-config-daemon,...,worker,false
  ```
- **Root Cause:** `validation_test.go:52`'s BeforeEach loads the documented static entries from the `release-4.23` CSV files and then checks (`validation_test.go:141`) that every documented port is open on the cluster. TCP/8798 (`machine-config-daemon` direct metrics, master+worker) and TCP/9192 (`machine-approver` kube-rbac-proxy, master) are present in `docs/stable/unique/common-master.csv` (lines 8, 17) and `docs/stable/unique/common-worker.csv` (line 4), but OCP 4.23 nightly no longer binds those ports — they have been superseded (MCD exposes metrics only via TCP/9001 kube-rbac-proxy proxy). No recent git commit introduced these entries; they predate `b6a7975` in `main` and exist identically on `release-4.23`. The first domino is OCP 4.23 removing the direct port bindings.
- **Breaking PR/Commit:** Unknown — ports were removed from OCP 4.23 platform side (upstream `openshift/machine-config-operator` and `openshift/cluster-machine-approver`), not in commatrix code. No commatrix commit is responsible.
- **Flake?** No — ports are consistently absent on OCP 4.23 nightly; this will fail every run until the matrix is updated.
- **Fix:** Remove TCP/8798 (master + worker) and TCP/9192 (master) from `docs/stable/unique/common-master.csv`, `docs/stable/unique/common-worker.csv`, and all `docs/stable/raw/*.csv` files on `release-4.23`. Also add TCP/9443 (`cloud-controller-manager-operator` webhook) and UDP/68 (`NetworkManager`) which are open but undocumented, as shown in `doc-diff-commatrix` (`+` entries).

## Summary Table

| # | Test | Group | Classification | Confidence | Root Cause (one line) | Fix |
|---|------|-------|----------------|------------|----------------------|-----|
| 1 | validation_test.go:52 BeforeEach / :141 It | A | test_regression | high | TCP/8798 and TCP/9192 stale in release-4.23 docs; OCP 4.23 nightly dropped those port bindings | Remove 3 stale entries from docs CSV on release-4.23 |

## Action Items
1. Open a PR on `release-4.23` removing `TCP/8798` (master+worker) and `TCP/9192` (master) from `docs/stable/unique/common-master.csv`, `docs/stable/unique/common-worker.csv`, and all `docs/stable/raw/*.csv`.
2. In the same PR, add `TCP/9443` (cloud-controller-manager-operator webhook, master) and `UDP/68` (NetworkManager, master+worker) which are currently open but undocumented per `doc-diff-commatrix`.

c0ee324f0cf947e4.ai_summary_short:
---

**TL;DR:** Test fails because `crio` ephemeral ports (32768+) are no longer filtered after Linux dynamic range was removed from `commatrix.DynamicRanges`.

**Overall Issue Class:** test_regression
**Overall Severity:** HIGH

## Root Cause Groups

### Group A — crio ephemeral ports not filtered (6 ports)
- **Tests:** `Validation [It] should validate the communication matrix ports match the node's open ports`
- **Classification:** test_regression | **Confidence:** high
- **Evidence:**
  - `port-map.txt`: `PORT 34425: Issues: NO_ENDPOINTSLICE, Ephemeral range: YES, users:(("crio",pid=2984,fd=11))`
  - `matrix-diff-ss`: `+ Ingress,TCP,34425,,crio,,,master,false` (and 5 more crio ports: 36223, 46593, 36971, 37187, 46743)
  - `communication-matrix.csv` (from test run): only `Ingress,TCP,30000-32767,,Kubelet node ports,,,,true` — Linux ephemeral range (32768-60999) absent
- **Root Cause:** `validation_test.go:157-161` calls `filterOutPortsOfKnownServices` (which skips only `rpc.statd` and `dnsmasq`) then `filterOutPortsInDynamicRanges` (which uses `commatrix.DynamicRanges` — now only the NodePort range 30000-32767). Commit `7d56343` (PR #400) removed the Linux ephemeral range from `DynamicRanges` to prevent over-broad firewall rules. This was correct for the matrix itself, but the test's `filterOutPortsOfKnownServices` was never updated to also skip `crio`, leaving its ephemeral ports (32768-60999) unfiltered and causing the `Fail()` at line 161.
- **Breaking PR/Commit:** Candidate (verified by artifact inference): commit `7d56343` merged via PR [#400](https://github.com/openshift-kni/commatrix/pull/400) (`1fec55d`) — confirmed on release-4.23 because `communication-matrix.csv` artifact contains no Linux ephemeral dynamic range.
- **Flake?** yes — crio assigns different random ephemeral ports each run; will fail consistently but with different port numbers.
- **Fix:** Add `crio` to `filterOutPortsOfKnownServices` in `validation_test.go:221-239`, or add a `isDynamicCrioPort` helper analogous to the existing `isDHCPClientPort` pattern.

### Group B — UDP/68 and TCP/9443 missing EndpointSlice (3 ports)
- **Tests:** `Validation [It] should validate the communication matrix ports match the node's open ports`
- **Classification:** test_regression | **Confidence:** medium
- **Evidence:**
  - `matrix-diff-ss`: `+ Ingress,TCP,9443,...cloud-controller-manager-operator,master,false`; `+ Ingress,UDP,68,,NetworkManager,,,master,false`; `+ Ingress,UDP,68,,NetworkManager,,,worker,false`
  - `doc-diff-commatrix`: same three entries marked `+` (open in cluster, absent from release-4.23 `bm.csv`)
- **Root Cause:** UDP/68 is the DHCP client (NetworkManager) — a host-level process with no EndpointSlice. The test has `isDHCPClientPort` exception in the *static-entries* test (line 217) but NOT in this test. TCP/9443 is the cloud-controller-manager admission webhook now active in OCP 4.23 with no EndpointSlice published. Both ports are detected by `ss` and survive all current filters. The release-4.23 `bm.csv` does not document either port.
- **Breaking PR/Commit:** Unknown — OCP 4.23 behavioral change for TCP/9443; missing `isDHCPClientPort` exemption predates this run for UDP/68.
- **Flake?** no — these ports are stable listeners present every run.

PR #400 removed that range from `GetDynamicRanges()` AND removed `LinuxDynamicPrivateDefaultDynamicRange` from `validation_test.go`'s doc-diff filter. The only remaining dynamic filter is 30000–32767 (Kubelet NodePorts), which does not cover 44405. Since CI runs test scripts from `main` against `release-4.23` cluster images, the stricter test now surfaces this port. The port itself is unchanged in 4.23 — it was always there, just previously filtered.
- **Breaking PR/Commit:** Candidate: [PR #400 / commit `7d56343`](https://github.com/openshift-kni/commatrix/commit/7d56343e0d6e32f2fcc9b639ada47bb83cc57740) — `Remove Linux Dynamic ranges` — on `main` only; not verifiable on `release-4.23` (no remote branch in local clone).
- **Flake?** No — crio consistently binds to this port; the missing filter is deterministic.
- **Fix:** Add `"crio"` to `filterOutPortsOfKnownServices` in `test/e2e/validation_test.go` (treating it like `rpc.statd` — ephemeral/streaming port with no EPS backing), OR investigate why crio uses an ephemeral port with no EndpointSlice and add proper documentation/EPS for it.

**TL;DR:** Test fails because `crio` binds TCP/33045 on the SNO node and the test's known-service filter does not exclude it.

**Overall Issue Class:** test_regression
**Overall Severity:** MEDIUM

## Root Cause Groups

### Group A — crio port 33045 not filtered as known service (1 test)
- **Tests:** `[It] should validate the communication matrix ports match the node's open ports`
- **Classification:** test_regression | **Confidence:** high
- **Evidence:**
  - `matrix-diff-ss`: `- Ingress,TCP,33045,,crio,,,master,false` (in ss, absent from EPS matrix)
  - `validation_test.go:161`: `Fail(fmt.Sprintf("the following ports are used but don't have an endpointslice: \n %s", missingEPSMat))`
  - `failure-log.txt`: `[FAIL] Validation [It] should validate the communication matrix ports match the node's open ports /tmp/secret/commatrix/test/e2e/validation_test.go:161`
- **Root Cause:** `crio` binds TCP/33045 on the SNO node (visible in `ss-generated-matrix.csv`). `crio` has no Kubernetes EndpointSlice, so it appears in `missingEPSMat` (ports open on node without EPS backing). Port 33045 is above the NodePort ceiling (32767) so `filterOutPortsInDynamicRanges` does not catch it. `filterOutPortsOfKnownServices` (in `test/e2e/validation_test.go:221`) only skips `rpc.statd`, `dnsmasq`, and `dig` — `crio` is not listed. All other `Missing` ports are correctly disposed of: rpc.statd via `filterOutPortsOfKnownServices`, and the ovnkube NodePort allocations (30613, 31434, 32546) via the NodePort dynamic range 30000–32767.
- **Breaking PR/Commit:** Candidate (unverified): `1fec55d` / PR #400 (`shirmoran/remove-linux-dynamic-range`) removed Linux ephemeral port ranges (~32768+) from `commatrix.DynamicRanges`; previously port 33045 fell inside that range and was silently filtered. The `scripts/check_backport.py` tool and a `release-5.0` remote ref are not present in this clone, so branch presence cannot be confirmed.
- **Flake?** No — TCP/33045 is deterministically open on every OCP 5.0 SNO boot; the failure is reproducible.
- **Fix:** Add `crio` to `filterOutPortsOfKnownServices` in `test/e2e/validation_test.go` (same pattern as the existing `rpc.statd` skip). Optionally add a comment explaining that crio binds a random TCP port for its stream/gRPC health endpoint that has no EndpointSlice.
